info.title: SuperlativeBridge API
info.description:
REST API backing the SuperlativeBridge platform. Runs on AWS Lambda + API Gateway in production and as a single Go HTTP server locally (docker compose). Data lives in Postgres.

Seeded demo accounts (password: `password123`): admin@example.com, maria@example.com (GIG worker), aisha@example.com (employer), sarah.mentor@example.com (mentor).
